name: cardworks
description: CARDWORKS — a constraint-based visiting card engine for Bangladesh

scripts.test: node cardworks-engine.test.cjs; e=$?; for f in tests/*.test.mjs; do printf '\n▸ %s\n' "$f"; node "$f" || e=1; done; exit $e
scripts.db:migrate: for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do echo "▸ $f"; psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:schema && npm run db:migrate
